exposure: timing of Mirena IUD insertion (during cesarean section vs. 42 days postpartum)
cohort: 96 women who received a Mirena IUD, divided into two groups: 48 who received the IUD during cesarean section and 48 who received it 42 days postpartum.
finding: There was no significant difference in IUD expulsion rate, infection, perforation, bleeding, or displacement between women who received the Mirena IUD during cesarean section and those who received it 42 days postpartum.
